name: Heraclius
title: Emperor Heraclius
summary: Heraclius was Byzantine emperor from 610 to 641. His rise to power began in 608, when he and his father, Heraclius the Elder, the Exarch of Africa, led a revolt against the unpopular emperor Phocas.
notes: Reign: 30 years, 4 months and 6 days. Heraclius is often seen as the last 'Roman' emperor in spirit before the empire became predominantly 'Byzantine' and Greek. His defeat by the Arabs at Yarmouk (636) was a turning point. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heraclius
